description: Request a Brand Discovery Record — the human-approved source of truth a brand provides to AI assistants and agents, maintained by Mirror. A Record is a machine-readable reference page, hosted by Mirror, stating a brand's verified facts with schema.org structured data and citations, and linking to the brand's own site as the canonical source. It is what a brand PUBLISHES so AI can find, read and cite it: Mirror measures, the Record responds. This is the one public tool of the Mirror switchboard; the measurement itself (a full Brand Reflection) is delivered by a person on request. IMPORTANT — this tool creates a REQUEST, not a Record. Nothing is published by calling it. Automated validation (Signal Input) runs immediately and its results are returned to you. Every Brand Discovery Record is reviewed by Daniels AI and approved by the organization it represents before publication. No autonomous process publishes a brand's machine-readable truth. Fill the fields below with verified, citable facts only. The Record specification is versioned; this tool reports the version it validated against.

brand_name.description: Exact public name of the brand.

citations.description: At least 3 authoritative sources from 3 DIFFERENT domains.

description.description: 1-2 factual sentences, ~160 characters. No marketing claims.

official_url.description: The brand's OWN official website (canonical). Must be the brand's domain — never Mirror's.

overview.description: Short factual prose — what the brand is.

positioning.description: The most clarifying fact: category, who it serves, and what it is NOT.

public_access.description: Is it open to the public? The confusion-killer field.

recognition.description: Awards or coverage, each traceable to a citation.

relationship.description: REQUIRED. Who is asking, and on whose behalf. Signal Input fails without it. Only a request from someone representing the brand can become an authorized Record. If you are trying this tool out, say "testing" — it is filed as a test, you still get the full Signal Input validation, and it never enters the review queue.

requester_contact.description: REQUIRED. A working email for Signal Review and Signal Approval follow-up. Example/reserved domains (example.com, .test, .invalid) fail Signal Input. Without it a Record cannot be authorized.

requester_note.description: Why this request is being made.

schema_type.description: schema.org @type — e.g. GolfCourse, Restaurant, LodgingBusiness, Organization, LocalBusiness.

tagline.description: One plain line: what it is and where.
